name: Liquid Glass
tagline: Blue-to-pink-to-amber gradient with soft blurred blobs and frosted translucent glass cards, visionOS style (extended from a single-slide specimen)

palette.description: Vivid blue-pink-amber gradient with white frosted glass and white type

typography.style: Semibold tight grotesk headlines with Instrument Serif italic accents on frosted panels

best_for: Works for consumer tech and design topics that want a spatial, glossy feel. Glass cards hold short metrics and headlines cleanly.
avoid_for: Avoid for long text, print handouts or conservative audiences.
